resources.string: ProfitRide reads the visible text in Bolt Driver and Uber Driver only to calculate the net profit of a ride and show it on screen. If text is not available it can take a screenshot, processed only on your phone and not saved. It never taps anything, never accepts or declines rides, and sends no data anywhere.

It takes a minute. Then ProfitRide shows the net profit of every ride, right over Bolt and Uber.
From the offer\'s price, kilometres and minutes it subtracts commission, fuel, wear and your taxes.
It sits in the middle of the screen, never covers the price, route or buttons, and can\'t be tapped.

Kotlin and AndroidX/Jetpack Compose (Apache License 2.0). Google ML Kit Text Recognition, model bundled in the app (Google ML Kit terms). Everything runs on the phone, offline.

The Provider does not guarantee that results are accurate, complete or fit for your purpose. You remain solely responsible for deciding whether to accept or decline a ride and for checking real amounts, distances and costs.

We may update these Terms. For a material change we ask for your consent again. You may stop at any time by uninstalling the App. The Provider may change or discontinue the App.

Romanian law applies. As a consumer you also benefit from the mandatory rules of the country where you live. For disputes you may go to the competent courts of Romania or of your country of residence. You may also contact ANPC (anpc.ro) or alternative dispute resolution bodies.
Controller: %1$s (identification: %2$s, address: %3$s). Contact for data questions: %4$s.
The App works locally. It has no internet access, no accounts, no advertising, analytics or tracking. The Provider does not receive and has no access to your data.

Your profile (country, car, consumption, costs, taxes, thresholds); offers read (price, distances, durations, time, platform, calculation result); rides you mark; income added manually; documents and expenses in Car (expiry dates, costs, odometer, plate number); app settings; your consent (version and date).
To calculate, the App temporarily reads visible text in ride apps (and, if needed, a locally processed screenshot). The text and screenshot are not saved. Only the offer values are kept in history.
Performing the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and your consent for the accessibility permission and notifications (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
Rides are deleted automatically after 400 days. Other data stays until you delete it or uninstall the app.
There are no recipients and no transfers: data does not leave your phone. If you choose to export and send the file, you decide who receives it.

Access and portability (Export button), rectification (edit data in the app), erasure (Delete buttons), restriction and objection, and withdrawal of consent (Withdraw consent button), without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing (Art. 15-22 GDPR). Data is in the app’s private storage on your phone and automatic backup is disabled. Protect your phone with a screen lock.
